sections.title: Welcome
sections.content: Communication can build connection or cause harm depending on how it is used.

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content: Healthy communication includes listening, clarity, honesty, and emotional regulation.

sections.title: Practical Skills
sections.content: Participants learn skills such as using 'I' statements and active listening.

sections.title: Activity
sections.content: Reflect on a recent conversation. What communication pattern did you use?

sections.title: Reflection
sections.content: Healthy communication requires awareness and practice.
